facts.text: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday sits down at the faro table.
facts.why: The film shows Wyatt dealing faro and Doc at a poker table, but Doc is never shown sitting down at the faro table; his famous moment is saying 'I'm your huckleberry' to Ringo.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday says "I'm your huckleberry."
